how_to_apply: Complete One-Time Registration (OTR) on the SSC website, https://ssc.gov.in. OTR generated on the old website (ssc.nic.in) will not work on the new website.
Log in using your Registration Number and Password, then click 'Apply' against the SSC SI in Delhi Police and CAPFs Examination, 2026.
Fill in the Online Application Form either on the SSC website or via the 'mySSC' mobile application (available on Google Play Store).

Candidates are advised to opt for Aadhaar-Based Authentication while completing OTR, which exempts them from photo/signature rejection on format grounds and from producing colour photographs/photo-ID at the exam venue.
Capture a live photograph as prompted by the application (no pre-existing photo upload) with good light, plain background, no cap/mask/glasses.
Upload scanned signature in JPEG format (10–20 KB, approx. 6.0 cm width x 2.0 cm height).
Use the Preview/Print option to check all details before final submission.
Pay the application fee of ₹100 online (if not exempted) through BHIM UPI, Net Banking, Visa, MasterCard, Maestro or RuPay Debit card.
Submit the application before 30.09.2026 (23:00 hrs) and complete fee payment before 01.10.2026 (23:00 hrs).
important_instructions: A candidate must be a citizen of India, a subject of Nepal, or a subject of Bhutan. The Commission neither collects vacancies nor allocates candidates state-wise, region-wise, zone-wise or city-wise for this examination. Candidates should submit applications well before the closing date to avoid last-minute website load issues; SSC is not responsible for failure to submit due to such reasons. Applications with incomplete fee payment status will be summarily rejected. After the correction window closes, no further change/correction/modification will be allowed under any circumstances. Candidates have the option to choose three examination centres (in order of priority) within the same SSC region; no request for centre change will be entertained later. Marks in multi-shift Computer Based Examinations will be normalized as per the Commission's published procedure. There is no provision for re-evaluation/re-checking of scores. Success in the examination confers no right to appointment unless the Commission is satisfied, after such enquiry as considered necessary, that the candidate is suitable in all respects. Candidates should retain their application forms and exam-related documents for at least 3 years for future reference. Information furnished in the application will be verified against original documents during Document Verification; false information will lead to summary rejection of candidature. Various penalties (ranging from 1 to 7 years' debarment) apply for unfair means, impersonation, misbehaviour, or possession of prohibited devices during the examination - full details are in the official notice.

content_sections.text: Vacancies are tentative and reported by the Ministry of Home Affairs (CAPFs) and Delhi Police; SSC does not decide or allocate vacancies state-wise, region-wise or force-wise. content_sections.text: A candidate must be a citizen of India, or a subject of Nepal, or a subject of Bhutan (subject to a certificate of eligibility issued by the Government of India for Nepal/Bhutan subjects). Bachelor's degree in Science with Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics from a recognised university or equivalent; OR Matriculation plus a 3-year diploma in Mechanical/Civil/Electrical/Automobile/Chemical/Mining/Aeronautical/Telecommunication Engineering or equivalent. A higher qualification (B.Tech/M.Tech) in relevant fields is treated as value addition, subject to the basic diploma being held.

content_sections.heading: SSC SI CAPF Recruitment 2026 Selection Process / Scheme of Examination
content_sections.text: The examination consists of four mandatory stages: Paper-I, Physical Standard Test (PST) / Physical Endurance Test (PET), Paper-II, and Detailed Medical Examination (DME). Questions in both papers are Objective Multiple Choice Type, set in Hindi and English (Parts I–III). Negative marking: 0.25 marks per wrong answer in Paper-I, 0.50 marks per wrong answer in Paper-II. Difficulty level of Paper-II is higher than Paper-I. NCC Certificate holders get bonus marks: 5% (NCC 'C'), 3% (NCC 'B'), 2% (NCC 'A') of maximum marks in each paper, as on the closing date of application. Height and chest requirements vary by post (SI Delhi Police / SI CAPFs / SI Fire CISF) and candidate category (general, hill areas, Scheduled Tribes, Gorkha, North-Eastern States, etc.), ranging from 154 cm to 170 cm for height depending on category and gender. Female candidates have no minimum chest measurement requirement. Weight must correspond to height for all posts. PST/PET is qualifying/eliminating in nature and does not carry marks. Relaxation in height/chest is permitted only on production of the prescribed competent-authority certificate. Ex-Servicemen are exempted from PET but must clear the written tests, physical standards and medical standards prescribed for direct recruits. All candidates who qualify Paper-II undergo a Detailed Medical Examination (DME) by CAPF Medical Officers. A Review Medical Examination (RME) is conducted for candidates found unfit in DME, preferably the next day; the decision of the Review Medical Board is final. DME/RME is mandatory but qualifying in nature. Document Verification is conducted by the CAPFs before final result declaration, preferably alongside the DME/RME stage. Candidates must bring two passport-size colour photographs, one original valid Photo ID proof, and originals plus copies of: Matriculation/Secondary Certificate, Educational Qualification Certificate, equivalence order/letter (if applicable), Caste/Category Certificate (if reserved category), Driving Licence (for Delhi Police male candidates), and Ex-Servicemen undertaking/certificates (if applicable).

faq.question: Q1. What is SSC SI CAPF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: SSC SI CAPF Recruitment 2026 is conducted by the Staff Selection Commission (SSC) to recruit candidates for the posts of Sub-Inspector (GD) in CAPFs, Sub-Inspector (Executive) in Delhi Police, and Sub-Inspector (Fire) in CISF.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are released under SSC SI CAPF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 1,871 tentative vacancies are available, including SI in Delhi Police, SI GD in CAPFs, and SI Fire in CISF posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the SSC SI CAPF Recruitment 2026 application date?
faq.answer: The online application process starts on 10 September 2026 and the last date to submit the application form is 30 September 2026 (23:00 hrs).

faq.question: Q4. What is the eligibility qualification for SSC SI CAPF 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a Bachelor’s degree from a recognised university or equivalent for SI in Delhi Police and SI GD in CAPFs. For SI Fire in CISF, candidates must have a relevant Science degree or engineering diploma qualification as specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for SSC SI CAPF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is 20 to 25 years for SI in Delhi Police and SI GD in CAPFs. For SI Fire in CISF, the age limit is 18 to 30 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per government rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for SSC SI CAPF Exam 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is ₹100. Women candidates, SC, ST, and eligible Ex-Servicemen candidates are exempted from paying the application fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary of SSC Sub Inspector posts in Delhi Police and CAPFs?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive Pay Level-6 salary of ₹35,400 to ₹1,12,400 along with applicable allowances.

faq.question: Q8. Can final year graduation students apply for SSC SI CAPF 2026?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates awaiting their final graduation results can apply, but they must possess the required qualification by the closing date mentioned in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. How can I apply online for SSC SI in Delhi Police and CAPFs Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online through the official SSC website ssc.gov.in or through the mySSC mobile application before the last date.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for SSC SI CAPF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process includes: Paper-I Computer Based Examination Physical Standard Test (PST) / Physical Endurance Test (PET) Paper-II Computer Based Examination Detailed Medical Examination (DME) Document Verification
